prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for Turnip Works, heroic hand-painted miniature game art. One architectural carved CORBEL bracket, not a freestanding statue: a stout wedge-shaped block projecting out from a flat vertical wall mounting back, with a wide FLAT HORIZONTAL TOP shelf to carry a beam. Under that top shelf its front is carved as a peaceful raven with folded wings perched on an hourglass. Back is a completely flat vertical plane; top completely flat. No surrounding wall, no beam, no floor pedestal. Dimensions 24 inches wide, 24 deep, 30 tall. The carving dominates the room-facing front and is readable when this bracket sits just under a beam. Front faces +Z, wall mounting back -Z. Palette: warm ivory and ink black. Stout connected forms, broad bevels, clear part separation, matte painted gradients, restrained surface texture, no glossy PBR. Exactly one complete object centered with generous clear margin, no scene or additional objects, no text, no logos, no specific published mythology or recognizable product design. Three-quarter view from ABOVE, camera elevation 50 degrees so the top and front are visible. Genuinely transparent background, no floor or cast shadow. Thick reconstructible parts; no wires, chains, delicate horns, thin spikes or isolated floating components.

blind.details: There are no text, labels, or watermarks present. The image shows a single complete object, best described as an architectural corbel or wall bracket shelf (second guess: a decorative gothic wall sculpture or bookend). It consists of a flat, rectangular cream-colored stone top ledge, supported underneath by a frieze decorated with diamond studs and dark recessed panels. The left side features a Gothic tracery arch with a quatrefoil relief. Nestled beneath the shelf is a fully sculpted black raven with detailed overlapping feathers, sharp beak, and blank light eyes, perched with two clawed feet atop a stone hourglass. The hourglass contains clear glass globes with fine cream-colored sand inside. Flowing acanthus-style scrollwork surrounds and supports the hourglass and raven from below. The object has zero doors, drawers, lids, wheels, or moving parts. Materials appear to be polished and aged cream-colored limestone or marble combined with charcoal/slate-black carved stone or matte resin. The entire object is fully contained within the frame with no cropping, isolated against a solid, seamless white background with no floor, shadows, people, or scenery.
